headline: TWO INSPECTIONS RUN THIS MORNING AND A LISTING AGREEMENT DIES TOMORROW — Altamont at 10:00 and Fieldstone at 11:15 are the two gates standing in front of your two newest contracts, and 198 Rena's number is still unruled with one day left on the clock. · DO: two inspections today, then rule the Rena number · WATCH: Lake Crest's last receipted close date is TOMORROW and nothing has crossed this desk on that file since 8/4.

notes: 🟢 THE FLEET RAN A NORMAL MORNING FOR THE FIRST TIME IN NINE DAYS. Six routines fired between 5:32 and 6:47 AM — money machine, inbox triage, finance, database power, ISA sweep, marketing — and the advisor letter went out at 6:47, the first full letter since 8/4. The longest gap between any two routines was 25 minutes, which is inside normal. Nothing is dark and nothing is silently catching up.

🔴 THE MIGRATION COST A RULING, NOT JUST DATA — AND IT WAS CAUGHT ONE STEP BEFORE IT MATTERED. Gene's 8/7 ruling that lead follow-up mail is DRAFT-ONLY was made on the MacBook and never existed in any file on this machine. The reconnect lane read the old greenlight and would have AUTO-SENT 15 client emails this morning. It staged ZERO instead and raised the flag. The ruling has now been written back to disk, so it survives the next machine change. The standing lesson: a rollback reverts DECISIONS as well as records, and a permission is only real if it lives in a file on the machine that acts on it.

⚠️ TWO SOURCE FREEZES ARE STILL IN FORCE AND WERE RE-TESTED THIS MORNING, NOT ASSUMED. The commercial listing sites behind Tyler's Nashville and Knoxville lanes hit their 7-day retry mark today and both refused again — that is seven straight refusals. The beach lane's source has actually MOVED DOMAINS and the new host will not answer at all; a replacement source was tried this morning and refused too. Those lanes now carry a last-verified date on their face rather than presenting three-week-old prices as fresh.

callBlock.who: Ann & Don C. — the Rena listing agreement expires TOMORROW and the number is still unruled
callBlock.why: ⏰ ONE DAY LEFT. THIS IS THE ONLY HARD DEADLINE ON THE BOARD AND IT HAS BEEN OPEN ELEVEN DAYS. ⭐ THE EXTENSION ITSELF IS ALREADY SETTLED — you emailed the ask 8/12 and told them a decision is due Friday in your own seller report. So do not walk in re-opening a question you've already closed. ⭐ WHAT IS STILL OPEN IS ONE THING ONLY: THE NUMBER. Reprice at the extension, or extend and hold the current ask. ⭐ THE DESK'S READ IS UNCHANGED AND THE EVIDENCE IS THE FILE'S OWN HISTORY — eighty-eight days at this price produced exactly one written offer, and the co-op agent volunteered that offer as their client's ceiling. ⚠️ THE HONEST COUNTER: a genuine full-price showing ran Tuesday 8/11, and you chased that agent for the read on 8/12 with no answer yet. Worth one more check of your inbox before you dial — but traffic without offers for eighty-eight days is the textbook shape of a price problem, not a marketing one. ⭐ AN EXPIRED AGREEMENT IS A CLOSING YOU ALREADY PAID FOR AND THEN HANDED BACK.

callBlock.who: Kelsie C. — your Fieldstone buyers have questions and their inspection is at 11:15 THIS MORNING
callBlock.why: 🔥 CLIENT-WAITING, AND THE CLOCK IS THIS MORNING. She and her husband asked for time; you countered with phone-first at 5:47 and it has not connected yet. ⭐ THE TIMING MAKES THIS EASY RATHER THAN HARD — the inspection is today, so there is a natural reason to call that isn't 'checking in': you can walk them through what happens in the next four hours and answer the questions in the same breath. ⚠️ QUESTIONS THAT GO UNANSWERED ON INSPECTION DAY BECOME REPAIR DEMANDS ON FRIDAY. This is a contract that came in TEN THOUSAND above list inside three weeks — the cheapest thing you can do to protect it is a five-minute call before the inspector's report exists.

callBlock.who: Cassie C. and Angela B. — the two agents who called Comanche too high and STILL don't know it came down
callBlock.why: 🔴 BOTH CHIPS ARE NOW FIVE DAYS OVERDUE AND THE ARGUMENT FOR THE CALL ONLY GOT STRONGER. Cassie's buyer toured 7/25, wrote the offer, and called the old ask too high. Angela's buyer toured 8/2, said interested YES, and called the same old ask too high. Neither has ever been told the price moved. ⭐ AND ON 8/11 A THIRD AGENT LOOKED AT THE NEW NUMBER AND CALLED IT JUST RIGHT — the first validating read this listing has produced in its life. ⭐ THAT IS THE WHOLE SCRIPT: you are not asking them to reconsider a number they rejected, you are telling them the number changed and a peer just validated it. ⚠️ STATED HONESTLY — Cassie's is a re-open of a dead deal at nineteen days and that buyer may well be under contract elsewhere. Both are still the cheapest at-bats you own. ⛔ Quote the current list price only; across six written reads not one agent has ever put a different number on paper. ⛔ Call, don't email — buyer's agents are the red lane under your own 8/7 rule.

callBlock.who: Bill R. — he opened his market report on his own and he is already at listing-agreement stage
callBlock.why: 🔥 STILL THE HIGHEST-INTENT SELLER SIGNAL IN THE DATABASE AND IT IS NOW THREE DAYS OLD. He is not a cold name — his record already sits at LISTING AGREEMENT stage, which means the relationship is well past introduction, and he chose to open your market report unprompted. ⭐ THAT COMBINATION IS THE BEST PAIR THIS SYSTEM CAN PRODUCE: someone who has already been through the listing conversation, re-engaging with pricing content on his own initiative. ⚠️ THE COST OF THE DELAY IS THE OPENER — 'I saw you looking at the numbers' lands on day one and gets stale by day five. Call today while the report is still the reason.

callBlock.who: Thomas D. — the freshest owned lead you have, off the White Tail Run land ad
callBlock.why: 🔥 FIRST EMAIL WENT OUT 8/12 AT 5:29 PM AND NOBODY HAS DIALED HIM. ⭐ THE AD ITSELF IS THE STORY WORTH KNOWING: the nineteen-lot package has produced four buyer signals in three days while every other ad in the portfolio produced zero. This is the one piece of marketing currently working, and the leads it makes are going to email instead of the phone. ⚠️ A CRM STATUS FIELD ON THIS RECORD READS 'SPOKE WITH CUSTOMER' AND IS EXPLICITLY DISTRUSTED — no call is logged anywhere this desk can read, so treat him as untouched by voice. ⭐ Land buyers self-qualify fast on the phone and slowly by email; one call decides whether he is real.

callBlock.who: Ulysses S. — he filed TWO seller forms one minute apart on the same address
callBlock.why: 🔥 SOMEBODY WHO FILLS OUT THE SAME SELLER FORM TWICE IN SIXTY SECONDS IS NOT BROWSING. That is either urgency or a form that didn't confirm — and both readings say call, not email. ⚠️ ONE VERIFICATION NOTE THAT MATTERS BEFORE YOU DIAL: a chip on this record was flagged as possibly carrying the wrong person's details, and it was deliberately left for you rather than machine-corrected. Pull the CRM record first and confirm the name against the address. ⭐ Thirty seconds of checking beats opening a seller call with the wrong name.

callBlock.who: Anthony M. and Lisa S. — the third and fourth buyers off your Fieldstone ad, neither ever called
callBlock.why: 🎯 TWO NAMES, ONE ORIGIN, ZERO PHONE TOUCHES BETWEEN THEM. Both came off the same listing ad within days of each other; one re-engaged on a Sunday afternoon and the other landed at 7:47 on a Sunday night. ⭐ THE STRATEGIC POINT IS THAT THE AD THAT MADE THEM IS ON A HOUSE THAT IS NOW UNDER CONTRACT — so these buyers are live and their reason for calling you is gone unless you give them a new one. That is the call: the home they asked about is spoken for, here is what else fits. ⚠️ Buyer leads off a pending listing decay faster than any other kind, because the next agent's ad answers the question yours can no longer answer.

callBlock.who: Detra W. — she asked for a professional valuation and it is five days unanswered
callBlock.why: ⚠️ THIS ONE IS A DIRECT REQUEST, NOT A SIGNAL, WHICH MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM EVERY OTHER ROW HERE. She asked for a professional valuation on a Panama City property in her own words. Nobody inferred her intent from a click — she stated it. ⭐ A HAND-RAISE THAT ASKS FOR A SPECIFIC DELIVERABLE IS THE SHORTEST PATH TO A LISTING APPOINTMENT THIS BOARD OFFERS, and it costs one call plus the valuation you already know how to build. ⏰ Five days is the outer edge of where 'thanks for your patience' still works.

listings.status: 🎉 UNDER CONTRACT $162K — the buyer's inspection is at 10:00 THIS MORNING
listings.note: ⏰ THE FIRST REAL GATE ON THIS DEAL IS IN A COUPLE OF HOURS. Confirmed on the ShowingTime notice, MLS already reading CONTINGENT. ⭐ THE FILE'S BACKSTORY IS WORTH CARRYING INTO TODAY: the buyer's agent said her client 'really, really liked it' but needed to save more for a down payment, and this desk argued for two weeks against reading that as a price signal — she had written JUST RIGHT on the same form. She wrote. Offer to acceptance in twenty-eight minutes. Patience was the right call and it is now on the record. ⚠️ ONE PAPERWORK ITEM RIDES ALONGSIDE THE INSPECTION AND IT IS A SIXTY-SECOND CHECK, NOT AN ALARM: the buyer's agent flagged on 8/12 that the seller initials were missing on paragraph 30, your transaction manager said it would go over 'shortly,' and no receipt of the returned document has appeared since. That is an ABSENCE, not a proven failure — confirm it before 10:00 rather than escalate it. ⭐ Contract-to-close is issued, the closing attorney and lender are named, and the attorney has confirmed receipt with a new office address. Closing is set for 9/14.

listings.status: 🎉 UNDER CONTRACT $390,000 — inspection 11:15 THIS MORNING, and the buyers have open questions
listings.note: ⏰ SECOND INSPECTION OF THE DAY, SEVENTY-FIVE MINUTES AFTER THE FIRST. Confirmed in your own weekly seller report to the sellers on 8/12. ⭐ THE HEADLINE NUMBER STILL DESERVES SAYING OUT LOUD: contract at $390,000 against a $380,000 list — TEN THOUSAND ABOVE ASK, inside three weeks. Your own 7/17 note had warned these sellers that taking the top of the band 'may extend sales time.' It did not, and that is the best possible thing to have been wrong about. 🔴 THE LIVE ITEM IS THE BUYER SIDE, NOT THE SELLER SIDE: the buyers have questions, you offered a phone call at 5:47 and it hasn't connected. Unanswered questions on inspection morning turn into repair demands by Friday. ⭐ ONE THING WORTH SAYING TO THE SELLERS BEFORE CLOSING: they cleared out three times in thirty hours during the showing burst without a word of complaint. That is exactly the kind of thing sellers remember when someone asks them for a referral.

listings.status: ⏰ Active $450K — THE LISTING AGREEMENT EXPIRES TOMORROW, 8/14
listings.note: ⏰ ONE DAY. Day 88, no price change since May. ⭐ THE EXTENSION IS RULED AND SHOULD NOT BE RE-ASKED — you emailed the ask on 8/12 and told the sellers in writing that a decision is due Friday. ⭐ WHAT REMAINS OPEN IS THE NUMBER ALONE: reprice at the extension, or extend and hold. ⭐ THE DESK'S REC IS THE REPRICE and the case is the file's own history — eighty-eight days at this price produced exactly one written offer, and the co-op agent volunteered that figure as their client's ceiling. ⚠️ THE COUNTER-EVIDENCE IS REAL AND SHOULD BE HEARD: a genuine full-price showing ran Tuesday 8/11 at 2:15, and the read was chased on 8/12 with no answer yet. ⚠️ A confirmed showing was also booked and cancelled on Sunday 8/9 — the second lost appointment on this file. ⭐ THE LEVERAGE FOR THE CONVERSATION IS UNCHANGED: both feedback forms this house has ever produced left every price field BLANK. The stated objections were the upstairs bathroom and a compartmentalized interior. Nobody who walked it said the number was wrong; they said the floor plan wasn't theirs. ⚠️ Quote $450,000 only until they rule.

listings.status: 🔴 Under contract $899K — the last receipted close date is TOMORROW and this desk has no receipt since 8/4
listings.note: 🔴 THE BIGGEST DEAL ON THE BOARD IS THE ONE THIS RUN CAN SAY LEAST ABOUT, AND THAT IS ITSELF THE FINDING — NOW WITH THE DATE ON TOP OF IT. Nothing has crossed this desk on this file since 8/4: no showing notice, no milestone, no correspondence. ⛔ THE LAST RECEIPTED CLOSE DATE IS 8/14 — TOMORROW — and the buyer's side had asked to push it to the 20th with no signed amendment ever appearing on any lane here. That ask was never resolved in anything this desk can read. ⚠️ Nine days of split-brain sit directly across that gap, so silence here means the machine was reading the wrong disk, NOT that the file went quiet. Read this row as 'this desk cannot see,' never as 'nothing happened.' ⭐ WHAT REMAINS VERIFIED AND GOOD: the appraisal is complete and clean on the lender's own words, which takes financing risk out of the date question entirely; the repair addendum is fully executed; the septic inspection ran 8/4. ⛔ Do not print the 20th as the close date on any surface — 8/14 is the last receipted one, and an unagreed push is an ask, not an agreement. 🔴 THIS IS THE FIRST COORDINATOR CALL OF THE DAY, ahead of everything else on this row.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $295K — the price objection BROKE, and three warm agents are still unworked
listings.note: 🔥 THE CHEAPEST CONTRACT AVAILABLE TO YOU IS STILL SITTING HERE. The 8/10 tour produced the first validating read in this listing's life: interested YES · priced JUST RIGHT · staging 5 of 5, the highest score it has ever recorded. ⭐ THE CAUSAL CHAIN IS CLEAN AND IT IS ON RECEIPTS: every read that ever touched the number said TOO HIGH — 7/25, 8/2, and the dead written offer — and every one of them was filed while the ask was $299,000. The cut went live 8/5. This is the first read since, and the objection is gone. A $4,000 experiment that worked. ⭐ SEVENTEEN SHOWINGS ALL-TIME MAKES THIS YOUR HIGHEST-TRAFFIC ACTIVE; the seventeenth ran Wednesday at 5:00 with a Century 21 agent and that read is still owed — a second independent read on the new number inside seventy-two hours would settle the pricing question either way. 🔴 THE UNWORKED PART IS THE WHOLE OPPORTUNITY: three separate co-op agents have expressed buyer interest here and TWO OF THEM STILL DO NOT KNOW THE PRICE MOVED. Both chips have been overdue since 8/8. ⚠️ NOBODY HAS EVER NAMED A REPLACEMENT NUMBER — every price-recommendation field across all six reads came back blank. ⛔ Quote $295,000 only. ⚠️ One open thread from the 8/10 tour: the buyer's agent asked in writing whether the ceiling stains came from a previous leak, and no answer is on record. Have it ready before you dial.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $184K — a 'VERY interested' buyer is now five days unworked
listings.note: 🔥 THE LISTING THIS BOARD ONCE CALLED INVISIBLE PRODUCED THREE TOURS IN A SINGLE SATURDAY. Three forms filed within ninety minutes of each other on 8/8. One answered the interest question with the single word 'Very' — every other field blank, which is exactly why it needs a phone call: the enthusiasm is on record and the reason is not. ✅ TWO LONG-STANDING BOARD ITEMS CLOSE HERE. The $5,000 cut the seller approved in July is VERIFIED LIVE AND PUBLIC — the MLS line on all three notices reads $184,000, so the old do-not-quote hedge is retired. And the twenty-day silence is over. 🔴 THE REAL FINDING IS THE OBJECTION AND IT IS VERIFIED THREE WAYS: the problem is SIZE, not price. The clearest read says it in four words — 'Just too small.' ⛔ NO DISCOUNT REACHES A SIZE OBJECTION. The answer on this listing is AUDIENCE, not number — first-time buyers, downsizers, investors — and a price conversation with this seller would be solving the wrong problem. This board argued for a cut here for weeks on the strength of silence; the showings arrived and said something different, and that earlier read is withdrawn. 🔴 The ad on this listing has produced zero leads in eleven days after being the best performer on record in July.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract — inspection AND appraisal both cleared, close receipted 8/28
listings.note: ✅ STILL THE CLEANEST FILE ON YOUR BOARD. Both gates are behind you: the inspection ran 8/5 at noon and the appraisal ran 8/7 at 9:00 AM, both confirmed on primary notices. ⭐ AN INSPECTION AND AN APPRAISAL BOTH SPENT IS THE STRONGEST POSITION ANY DEAL ON THIS BOARD OCCUPIES. ⚠️ THE APPRAISED VALUE HAS NOT COME BACK — that is day six with no number, and it is reported here as a single-source observation rather than an alarm, because a quiet appraisal is usually just a quiet appraisal. Worth one call to the lender, not a red flag. ⚠️ ONE ADMINISTRATIVE THREAD WAS LEFT UNSIGNED ON 8/4 — an address-correction addendum that sat on the signing platform without a receipt. It has not been re-checked and should be confirmed closed before this file is called clean. ⚠️ ONE NUMBER REMAINS UNRULED AND IT IS WORTH REAL MONEY ON AN OTHERWISE SETTLED DEAL: the buyer's agent asked for a specific co-op commission and nobody has ever answered. That is a decision, not a chore. ⭐ The client side is fully handled — a walkthrough of the earnest money and the inspection, financing and appraisal clocks already went out.

listings.status: ✅ Active $559K — still drawing tours, and the price reads are genuinely split
listings.note: ✅ IT KEPT PRODUCING TRAFFIC THROUGH THE ENTIRE DARK WINDOW — a tour 8/4 and another 8/10 at 2:00, on a listing that has taken forty showings all-time and was relisted after the prior contract was mutually released. ⚠️ THE 8/4 READ IS THE FIRST ONE THAT HURTS: interested No · priced TOO HIGH · staging 2 out of 5. ⭐ THE STAGING SCORE IS THE ACTIONABLE HALF, NOT THE PRICE HALF. A 2 is the lowest this listing has ever recorded, against a 4 three weeks earlier from an agent who called the price JUST RIGHT — the house did not get more expensive between those two visits, it got less presentable. 🔴 AND IT CORROBORATES AN ITEM THIS BOARD HAS CARRIED UNACTIONED FOR THREE WEEKS: the 7/23 read said dirty plus GLITCHING ELECTRICAL. An electrician and a cleaner are still cheaper than another lost buyer — and 'glitching' on a house whose contract was released for a reason nobody here has ever established may in fact be the answer to what killed it. ⚠️ THE PRICE EVIDENCE IS SPLIT TWO AND TWO, and not one of the four reads has ever named a replacement number. ⛔ Do not take a price conversation to an institutional seller off a split record. ⚠️ Quote $559,000 only.

listings.status: 🆕 Coming to market $185K — price now ruled, photographer wanted Monday, agreement OUT but NOT SIGNED
listings.note: ✅ THE PRICE QUESTION THIS BOARD CARRIED AS UNVERIFIED IS NOW ANSWERED — Gene ruled $185,000 this morning, so the number is quotable and the old 'no number may be printed' hedge is retired. ⚠️ THE SEQUENCING PROBLEM IS NOT: the sellers asked for the photographer on Monday, and the listing agreement went out for signature but is NOT SIGNED YET. Booking a shoot against an unsigned agreement is exactly how a shoot slips — and this same sequence already cost time on the Deer Ridge file two days earlier. ⭐ THE MOVE IS ONE CONVERSATION, NOT TWO: close the signature and book the shoot in the same call, rather than answering the photographer question in isolation. ⭐ Worth remembering what this relationship actually is — she came in unprompted off a listing alert saying they were very interested in a property AND about ready to list their own. This is the LIST half of a two-sided deal, and the BUY half has still never been worked.

listings.status: 🆕 Active $599K package — the only ad in the portfolio producing anything
listings.note: 🆕 FOUR BUYER SIGNALS IN THREE DAYS WHILE EVERY OTHER AD IN THE PORTFOLIO PRODUCED ZERO. This is currently the only marketing spend that is working, which makes how the leads are handled the real question — the freshest of them has an email out and no call logged. ⭐ ONE OF THOSE NAMES IS WORTH A SECOND LOOK BEFORE HE IS TREATED AS A RETAIL BUYER: one respondent works at an auction company, and on a nineteen-lot package that is a bulk-disposition conversation, not a lot sale. 🔴 THE OPEN ITEM IS A BUILDER QUESTION THAT IS NOW ROUGHLY A DAY OLD: a land company principal asked in writing whether the lots have had septic perc testing. A holding answer with the blocks-and-takedown option is drafted, the question has been delegated, and the loop is not closed. ⚠️ THAT QUESTION IS THE GATE ON THE WHOLE PACKAGE — perc results decide buildability, buildability decides price per lot, and a builder who gets no answer assumes the worst. ⭐ Blocks and takedowns at a higher per-lot number remain acceptable per the seller's own ruling; the single-package price is the anchor, not the only shape.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active — price cut to $285K on 8/11, and the live ad still shows the old number
listings.note: ⚠️ A PRICE CUT THAT THE MARKETING NEVER HEARD ABOUT. The listing came down to $285,000 on 8/11 per the CRM's own field, while an 8/8 social post that is still live carries $289,900. ⭐ THAT IS A CHEAP FIX AND A REAL ONE — a public ad quoting a dead number is the kind of small inconsistency buyers and agents actually notice, and it makes every other number you publish slightly less trustworthy. ⚠️ THIS IS TWO ARTIFACTS RATHER THAN TWO INDEPENDENT SOURCES, so it is printed as a waiting-on-you item rather than a red flag: the CRM field and the live post disagree, and the MLS has not been read directly to break the tie. ⭐ The corrected creative is already staged for approval, which means the whole item is one click rather than a project.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $1.15M — biggest listing in the book, seller identity STILL unverified
listings.note: ⚠️ THE LARGEST NUMBER ON YOUR BOARD IS STILL THE ONE WITH THE WEAKEST FILE. No showing, no feedback and no correspondence has crossed this desk on this address in the fourteen-day window. ⛔ THE CLIENT IDENTITY REMAINS UNVERIFIED under the identity law — a name is carried in memory, and memory is not a receipt. On a $1.15M listing that is not a formality: it gates every piece of client-facing creative and every seller email. ✅ ONE THING DID MOVE THIS WEEK — the marketing gap on this address was closed and the acreage detail was ruled directly by Gene, so the lane is firing again after twelve days dark. ⭐ THE POSITIONING READ IS STILL THE MOST USEFUL THING ON THE FILE: the only tour this listing ever took said, verbatim, that the buyer liked the house but the land wasn't what he was looking for. The objection is ACREAGE — which at this price point is the cheapest possible loss, because nobody has said it is too expensive. ⭐ THE UNANSWERED QUESTION IS THEREFORE A TARGETING ONE: who is the buyer who wants THIS land, and is the marketing pointed at them. ⏰ The 8/2 open house was never debriefed and its sign-in sheet has never been captured — eleven days on, that is effectively lost. 🛑 The security item on this address stands unchanged: the lookalike meeting link is not to be opened, on any device.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — thirteen days quiet, and the list price still reads two ways
listings.note: 🔴 TWO TOURS IN FIVE DAYS AT THE END OF JULY, THEN NOTHING SINCE. On a listing that had gone 126 days with essentially no traffic, that brief burst was the only real activity this file has produced and it has fully decayed. ⚠️ A PRICE DISCREPANCY OPENED DURING THE DARK WINDOW AND IS FLAGGED RATHER THAN RESOLVED: the last primary source this desk holds prints one number and a routine's later summary carries another, five thousand apart. ⛔ NEITHER IS QUOTABLE UNTIL THE MLS IS READ DIRECTLY — one of them is stale and this desk cannot tell which. ⭐ THE GOOD NEWS ON THIS FILE IS STILL UNDELIVERED AT THIRTEEN DAYS, WHICH MAKES IT THE OLDEST OWED ITEM ON THE BOARD: the 7/31 read came back interested No, but with the price called JUST RIGHT, a 4-of-5 rating, and the comment that the buyers prefer the east end of the beach although they liked this complex. That is a GEOGRAPHY loss, not a price loss, and it is the only independent validation of this list price the file has ever carried. ⭐ He is out of state and lives on these reads. Lead with the price answer, not the no. ⚠️ The publish-to-seller switch is unclicked here, so nothing reaches him automatically.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — the tenant answer she asked for is now nineteen days owed
listings.note: 🔴 THE LONGEST-RUNNING BROKEN PROMISE ON THE BOARD, AND IT HAS NOW RUN THROUGH AN ENTIRE FLEET MIGRATION. She left a twenty-two-second voicemail on 7/25 rather than sending a seventh text — which is what a patient client does when nothing comes back — and it is day nineteen with no reply on any lane this desk can read. ⭐ THE OWED THING IS YOURS, NOT HERS: she asked whether the tenant on this unit is out. You said he had told you he would call and had not. She came back with the part that matters — he owes another month's rent if he isn't out. ⚠️ YOU DO NOT NEED AN ANSWER TO MAKE THIS CALL, AND WAITING FOR ONE IS EXACTLY WHAT TURNED SIX DAYS INTO NINETEEN. 'Still no word from him, here's exactly what I'm doing about it' beats a twentieth day of silence. ✅ A draft on a separate thread with her is already staged this morning, which means the channel is open — the tenant answer is the piece that still isn't in it. ⭐ SHE IS NOT A LOOSE END, SHE IS A RELATIONSHIP WITH TWO LIVE THREADS: she closed with you in June, still opens your market reports, and has an unclosed valuation loop on this same address.

listings.status: 🆕 Buyer-side pending — long fuse, one answer owed
listings.note: 🆕 REAL GCI THE FORECAST COULD NOT SEE UNTIL LAST WEEK — roughly $44.6K across this address and a second buyer-side file, both weighted at zero in every prior model. That is not new business; it is business you already had that the system was blind to. ⭐ ONE LIVE OPEN ITEM AND IT IS NOW MORE THAN A WEEK OLD: a builder change-order and pre-qualification message, deliberately left in the inbox rather than filed because it is the only thing on this file that wants an answer. ⚠️ Long fuse — it closes late January 2027 with a production builder — so the change order is the only item carrying urgency, and a week of silence on a builder question is how change orders get decided without you.

listings.status: 🔴 Buyer-side $2.35M — the counter has never been put on paper, day 23
listings.note: 🔴 THE LARGEST SINGLE NUMBER ON YOUR BOARD, ROUGHLY $36K OF GCI, AND THE WHOLE COST OF MOVING IT IS TWENTY MINUTES OF WRITING. The listing side has asked repeatedly since 7/21 to be moved forward and has never received a written position from your side. ⚠️ STATED HONESTLY: a phone call leaves no receipt, so this is ABSENCE rather than proven failure — but what was promised was paper, and there is none on any lane this desk can read. ⭐ WHY IT KEEPS RETURNING: a seller who reverse-offers a buyer is a seller who wants a deal, and the honest answer IS the counter. Sending it is not a favour to them; it is your position on the record. ⚠️ NOT ASSERTED, AND THIS MATTERS BEFORE ANYTHING GOES OVER: the appraisal figure your buyer cited as far under ask is single-sourced from him. Whose appraisal it is, when it was done, and whether it is a formal appraisal at all are all unknown. Do not quote it to the other side as an appraised value. ⚠️ Three feedback requests from the listing side also remain unanswered.

listings.status: 🎉 Closed + funded — and the referral window on both is wide open
listings.note: ⏰ THE POST-CLOSE REVIEW-ASK ON LAKE FOREST IS NOW TWENTY-THREE DAYS OPEN. On a board where the large majority of this year's closings came from relationships rather than ads, and which needs roughly two contracts a week to reach the goal, this is the single cheapest referral at-bat available and it has sat untouched for three weeks. The gratitude call queued a month ago still has not happened. ⚠️ One open courtesy: the other office still owes those sellers the deed for utilities. 🎯 WHISPERING PINES IS STILL THE ONE UNRESOLVED UNIT IN THE COUNT, and it is worth a number: settling the agent-of-record in your favour makes the year 23 instead of 22 and moves pace by nearly two full closings. That is production that costs a conversation and no selling — carried unresolved for more than a dozen boards now. ⚠️ The dossier index says it is a teammate's file and this console says contested; one of those is wrong and only the conversation settles it.

pipeline.note: 🟢 22 OF 45 AT DAY 225, ANNUALIZING TO ABOUT 36 — and the counter moved TWICE in one week for the first time this year: 1709 Fieldstone at $390,000 on 8/8 (ten thousand ABOVE list) and 3350 Altamont at $162,000 on 8/11, offer to acceptance in twenty-eight minutes. ⚠️ ONE DESK CONFLICT IS PRINTED HONESTLY RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: the money desk counts 22 and the finance desk counts 21. This board counts 22 on the strength of the 683 Flag closing receipt; one file needs correcting so the two agree. ⭐ THE STRATEGIC POINT IS BIGGER THAN THE TWO UNITS: ten days ago the forecast named eight actives and asked which two would convert by October 31.
